title: aloysia ligustrina var. schulziae
intro: Aloysia ligustrina var. schulziae, commonly known as Chilean tea tree, is a species of flowering plant in the family Verbenaceae. The plant is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include relief from colds, fever, and other respiratory issues due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Aloysia ligustrina var. schulziae include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its ability to soothe and protect the body. The bioactive constituents of this plant include essential oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
